changelog:
- Initial public release of AIUSD Core skill.
- Provides structured trading tools and account management for AI agents.
- Supports unified trading across venues, perpetual futures, prediction markets, staking, and fund management via a single CLI.
- Includes domain-specific guides and clear authentication flows (create wallet, browser login, restore from backup).
- Emphasizes best practices: always guide before executing, confirm trades, handle ambiguous asset names, and present results clearly.
summary: AIUSD Core — structured trading tools and account management for AI agents. Use when user wants to buy/sell assets, check balances, stake, or manage positions.
